spatial_summary.negative_negative_coverage_conclusion: Negative-negative region is represented by approved human sources; scenes52..55 are not exact repeats. Nearby XY does not imply identical gripper pose, object contacts, failure history or full trajectory coverage.
spatial_summary.public_coverage_limit: Public37 actions/states were audited for tempo but public full object layouts were not reconstructed; do not claim public training excludes these spatial relations.

visual_relation_review.method: Viewed saved initial-agentview images for scenes49,52,54,55,57 only, no new rendering.
evidence: scene052 target shifted toward the other black bowls compared to49/57.
scene054/055 target visually close to another black bowl; touching/occlusion risk increases, especially55.
Target in negative scenes still appears nearer the plate than the other black bowl, so language ambiguity is not established by these images.
visual_relation_review.limitations: Image review is qualitative; exact distractor/plate 3D distances and collision overlap were not extracted. Scene edit intended positions may settle after contact. A changed visual relationship should be flagged, not automatically relabeled or discarded.

model_state_limitation.conclusion: Current pi05 path does not condition action generation on proprioceptive state tokens or a continuous state embedding. State arrays are still supplied for shape/pipeline uses. Fine contact/gripper-phase discrimination relies on RGB, which may be ambiguous under occlusion.
model_state_limitation.required_experiment: Treat enabling discrete_state_input=True as a new training configuration with matching training/serve transforms and separate checkpoint lineage. Do not change serve alone and claim an equivalent model.

recommendations.action: Retain all previously approved five recovery clips and all new originals; use the audited phase sampler to lower slow ordinary-transfer dominance and preserve grasp/lift, plate alignment, stable release and retreat.
recommendations.reason: Public transport targets are much larger than manual0.1; more steps on identical mixture can reinforce slow-target behavior.

recommendations.action: Evaluate the phase-balanced checkpoint on a fixed position matrix and matched seeds, separate approach/grasp/carry/release/retreat metrics, and compare to parent checkpoint.
recommendations.reason: Nearby negative training positions exist, so do not call all failed negative positions untrained or blindly add steps.

recommendations.action: For persistent failures, add validated recovery from the actual failed gripper/target/distractor arrangement, followed continuously through a successful retry and release. Keep normal fast carry examples in the mixture.
recommendations.reason: Position-only proximity does not cover failed relative grasp pose or occluded-contact ambiguity. Samples should address demonstrated failure stages.

recommendations.action: After sampler contrast is evaluated, test state-conditioned pi05 as a separate train-and-serve-consistent experiment if release/grasp-phase ambiguity persists.
recommendations.reason: Existing RGB-only path does not directly observe measured finger opening/EEF pose. This is a plausible limitation, not yet a proven sole failure cause.
